video.title: Which is the Best Programming Language for Devops Engineers ?👨‍💻 #devops #coding

transcript.text: which programming language should I
learn as a cloud or devops engineer as a
devops engineer it's very important to
have knowledge of at least one
programming language among these three
number one is going to be python so
python is the best programming language
to create automation scripts for your
everyday devops tasks like automating
backups creating web hooks integration
with tools like ansible and lot more
python has a large number of libraries
and tools along with very easy syntax
number two is going to be go so go or
golang is relatively new but very
popular programming language used to
create Cloud native applications
microservices and Network Tools also
devops tools like Docker and kubernetes
are created in go language so using go
along with these tools can help you
integrate and give more performance and
scalability number three is going to be
bash so bash is a shell scripting
language widely used for automating
devops task using bash you can monitor
services update software packages create
infrastructure and anything that you can
think of so bash is a very popular
language
